hook_text: Lost 400 staring contests to my phone

song.title: Close Your Eye
song.style: English, shimmering 80s synthpop with bright analog synths, gated drums, pulsing bass and sparkly arpeggios, warm friendly male lead vocal, dramatic and fun, 120 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Every night we lock our eyes
Me and the screen, no compromise
I never blink, it never sleeps
It wins the round, it always keeps

[Chorus]
Close your eye, close your eye
Let me win just one time
Close your eye, close your eye
I'll go look up at the sky

[Verse]
I tucked it in an orange sleeve
It shut its eye, I took my leave
I stared at clouds and stared at trees
I stared at you, you stared at me

[Chorus]
Close your eye, close your eye
I finally won, I could cry
Open mine, open wide
There's a whole world outside

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up: {moss} glares unblinking into a phone held right in front of his face, its screen showing one huge cartoon eye staring back at him. The camera dolly zooms. Warm lamp light on his face.
Extreme close-up of a phone screen filled with one huge unblinking cartoon eye with a blue iris. The camera pushes in slowly. Dark room, warm lamp glow.
{moss} and a phone propped against a teapot face off across a kitchen table, nose to screen. The camera whip pans back and forth between them. Warm lamp light.
Extreme close-up: the eyes of {moss} water and twitch behind his round black glasses as he refuses to blink. The camera crash zooms in. Warm lamp light.
{moss} keeps staring at a phone at the kitchen table as the window behind him turns from day to night to day. The camera slowly pulls back. Warm lamp light.
Extreme close-up: {moss} finally blinks and slumps in defeat. The camera crash zooms in. Warm lamp light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, defeated, slumped over the kitchen table. The camera pushes in. Warm lamp light.
{moss} face-plants onto the kitchen table in defeat beside a phone propped against a teapot. Top-down, the camera spins. Warm lamp light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, pleading with his hands clasped together. The camera orbits fast around him. Warm lamp light.
{moss} drops a striped tea towel over a phone on the table and the towel slowly slides off again. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm lamp light.
{moss} falls to his knees on the kitchen floor and throws both arms up to the ceiling dramatically. The camera cranes up above him. Warm lamp light.
Extreme close-up: the bushy brown mustache of {moss} droops sadly. The camera tilts down. Warm lamp light.
{moss} throws open wooden window shutters and bright sunlight floods over his face. The camera rushes past him toward the window. Bright morning light.
A big fluffy white cloud drifts over a city of rooftop gardens. The camera cranes up into the sky. Bright blue morning.
{moss} stands on a sunny rooftop garden staring up at the bright blue sky with his arms spread wide. The camera orbits fast around him. Bright morning sun.
A single white pigeon lands on a rooftop railing and stares at the camera. The camera whip pans to it. Bright morning sun.

A slim terracotta-orange sleeve stands upright on a soft pale green backdrop, a phone tucked inside so only its top edge peeks out, the sleeve's top edge cut like a closed eyelid with black lashes. Soft leaf shadows drift across the backdrop. Warm daylight. The camera slowly pushes in as the light turns warmer.
{moss} leans close to a terracotta-orange sleeve on his desk, squints at it suspiciously, then grins and pumps his fist. The camera crash zooms in. Warm daylight.
{moss} strides out of his round green front door into a sunny street lined with trees and bicycles. The camera tracks backward in front of him. Bright morning sun.
{moss} leaps and clicks his heels together on the sidewalk. Low angle, the camera whips up with him. Bright morning sun.
{moss} lies on his back in a sunny meadow staring up at big puffy clouds drifting by. Top-down, the camera cranes down onto him. Warm golden light.
{moss} presses his nose against the trunk of a huge oak tree, staring at its bark up close. The camera orbits around the tree. Dappled sunlight.
{moss} and a woman with a big curly red afro in a yellow sweater sit across a little cafe table in a staring contest, nose to nose. The camera whip pans between their faces. Warm afternoon sun.
A woman with a big curly red afro in a yellow sweater bursts out laughing first and {moss} throws his arms up in victory. The camera crash zooms in. Warm afternoon sun.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, on a sunny cafe terrace full of flower pots. The camera pushes in. Warm afternoon sun.
{moss} and a woman with a big curly red afro in a yellow sweater high-five over the cafe table. Close-up, the camera spins around their hands. Warm afternoon sun.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, with happy tears behind his glasses, holding up a tiny wooden trophy. The camera pulls back fast. Golden light.
A woman with a big curly red afro in a yellow sweater places a tiny wooden trophy into the hands of {moss}, who raises it to the sky. The camera cranes up. Golden light.
{moss} stands in a rooftop garden at sunset and opens his eyes wide at a huge orange sun. FPV, the camera flies around him. Warm sunset light.
Extreme close-up of round black glasses reflecting a glowing orange sunset, eyes wide open behind them. The camera pushes in. Warm sunset light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, friends laughing on a rooftop under warm string lights behind him. The camera slowly pulls back. Warm string-light glow at dusk.
{moss} lies back on a rooftop blanket under warm string lights and closes his eyes peacefully, the city glowing below. The camera slowly rises above him. Warm glow against a deep blue dusk.

caption: moss lost every staring contest to his phone. then the Eyelid closed its eye and he finally won. undefeated since
